item.title: Armed robbery reported in Spring Valley, suspect at large
item.description: The San Diego Sheriff's Office is responding to reports of an armed robbery in Spring Valley, with a perimeter set up around the area but no suspect in custody as of 10:30 p.m.

item.title: More than a haircut: San Diego barbershop fosters community with care and talk
item.description: Freshly Faded Barbershop in North Park is a unique space that celebrates African American culture, provides a therapeutic environment for conversation and offers health services to the community.

item.title: Candlelight vigil held for Poway hit-and-run victim
item.description: A candlelight vigil was held for the victim of a fatal hit-and-run crash that happened near Poway on Saturday night.

item.title: Actor Robert Duvall dies at 95, wife announces
item.description: He died "peacefully at home, surrounded by love and comfort."

item.title: San Diego County native joins the Banana Ball universe
item.description: Kaz Egan, a Fallbrook native, has been hired as the in-game voice for the Firefighters, one of the six teams in the Banana Ball league.

item.title: Free sandbags amid heavy rain in San Diego
item.description: Chula Vista and City of San Diego residents are encouraged to pick up free sandbags to protect their properties from the severe storm.

item.title: Flooding forces Midway District businesses to close
item.description: Heavy rainfall and flooding forced businesses to close in San Diego's Midway District.

item.title: Pair of Pacific storms coming to Southern California: Here's what to expect
item.description: Two Pacific storms are expected to bring widespread rain and mountain snow, strong winds, and a chance of thunderstorms to Southern California this week.

item.title: Downed tree in Pacific Beach falls on nearby home and vehicle amid storm
item.description: A large pine tree fell in Pacific Beach on Monday afternoon, landing on a Tesla and a nearby house, as a heavy storm slammed San Diego County, with no injuries reported.

item.title: Live Updates: Pacific storm downs tree, causes travel delays in San Diego County
item.description: The first of two strong Pacific storms this week has brought downpours, gusty winds, transit delays and flooding to Southern California.
